memory_files.rule: claude.md files at project root (or global ~/.claude/claude.md) are always injected into context. Use them to encode persistent rules, persona, and project constraints. Never rely on conversational memory.

commands.double_escape_rewind: surgical trim without full clear; preferred for mid-session course correction

permission_gates.whitelisting: add per-command allowances in .claude/settings.local.json to reduce friction on known-safe ops

planning_mode.use_case: wide-scope multi-file changes where you need a plan before execution
planning_mode.caution: plan quality is variable; avatar example over-implemented despite tight spec. Review plan before approving.

extended_thinking.visibility: thinking blocks render as faded gray text; new window into between-tool-call reasoning
extended_thinking.use_when: ambiguous architecture decisions or debugging complex multi-file issues

custom_commands.argument_injection: dollar-sign variables ($1, $2) injected at run time; square-bracket heuristic for multi-arg commands (undocumented, empirically derived)

sub_agent_protocol.pattern: ticket.md handoff — write task spec to shared markdown file, hand off to sub-agent, sub-agent reads and executes
sub_agent_protocol.benefit: clean context separation for long or parallel tasks

layers: connector skills (how Claude reaches external tools)

team_models.hyper_specialist: deep single-domain agents; compose for coverage
team_models.hyper_generalist: broad single agent; risks context dilution on complex projects

MCP_SERVER_SETUP.windows_gotcha: cmd /c prefix required; manual npx arg handling needed
MCP_SERVER_SETUP.http_remote_fallback: use HTTP remote MCP when local server fails on Windows
MCP_SERVER_SETUP.mcp_vs_traditional_agents: traditional agents degrade with 10+ tools; MCPs solve tool-sprawl via scoped, composable server architecture
MCP_SERVER_SETUP.agent_builder_pattern: node-based workflow graphs + MCP tool integrations; code quality gates at graph boundaries

cursor_2_0.composer: multi-file agent mode; use for cross-file changes
cursor_2_0.chat: question / explain mode; use @mentions to inject file context
cursor_2_0.image_to_code: paste design screenshot, get HTML/CSS scaffold
cursor_2_0.multi_agent: concurrent Composer sessions for parallel workstreams
cursor_2_0.core_value: local dev control + transparent diffs over copy-paste chat

windsurf.cascade_memories: persistent project memory analogous to claude.md
windsurf.multi_file_editing: in-line commands trigger cascading edits across dependent files
windsurf.inline_commands: natural-language instructions directly in editor gutter

vibe_coding_rules: Write rules files (claude.md / .cursorrules / cascade memories) before opening a chat
Iterate asynchronously: send task, do other work, return to review diff
Treat agent output as a PR, not final code: always review diffs
Constrain scope per session; wide-scope unconstrained prompts produce bloat
Use planning mode for architecture; use chat/composer for implementation

VOICE_AI_INTEGRATION.architecture_rule: lean LLM prompt + backend delegation via webhooks/MCP; never put business logic in the voice prompt

retell_ai.integration: n8n as headless backend; webhook triggers for appointment logic

vapi.use_case: outbound call workflows, multi-step voice agents
vapi.testing: test framework with scripted call scenarios before live deploy

api_guardrails.webhook_caps: enforce response size limits and rate limits
api_guardrails.trust_context_scoping: never trust caller-supplied context without signature verification
api_guardrails.fallback_planning: always define fallback path when voice agent cannot resolve intent

make_and_zapier.ai_agents_vs_traditional: traditional automation is deterministic/brittle; AI agents handle ambiguity but cost more per run
make_and_zapier.cost_model: task-based pricing; optimize by batching and caching upstream calls

async_polling_discipline.rule: never block the workflow thread; use polling loop nodes

twilio.concurrency: Promise.all.settled for bulk SMS ops (non-blocking, surfaces partial failures)
twilio.deduplication: Set data structure for message-log dedup
twilio.voices: Polly neural voices for TTS in voice flows
twilio.serverless_sig: protected function signature generation required for Twilio serverless endpoints

image_and_video_apis.replicate: GPU per-hour billing; idle cost is a trap for low-volume use
image_and_video_apis.kai_ai: unified API gateway aggregating VO3/Suno/Midjourney/Cling; pay-per-use model removes idle GPU cost
image_and_video_apis.fall_ai: pay-per-use GPU pricing; directly attacks Replicate cost game theory

steps: Notion AI: audience research + avatar creation + copywriting + awareness-level mapping + image prompt generation
Love Art: image and video generation from Notion-derived prompts
ad_creation_pipeline.swipe_file_filter: GetHooked 90+ day filter = ads still running = profitability signal; use as creative benchmark

AI_CREATIVE_PRODUCTION.ttfi_principle: TTFI (time-to-first-inference) latency is the UX/retention killer; optimize infrastructure speed over model speed

query_translation_strategies.multi_query: generate N reformulations of the query, union results
query_translation_strategies.rag_fusion: multi-query + reciprocal rank fusion for result merging
query_translation_strategies.decomposition: break complex question into sub-questions, answer each, synthesize
query_translation_strategies.step_back: abstract the question to a higher level before retrieval
query_translation_strategies.hyde: generate a hypothetical answer, embed it, retrieve by similarity

retrieval_trade_offs.dense: semantic similarity; strong on concept matching
retrieval_trade_offs.sparse: BM25 keyword; strong on exact term matching
retrieval_trade_offs.hybrid: combine both; use Cohere reranker for final scoring

memory_patterns.windowing: keep last N turns; cheap but loses long-range context
memory_patterns.summary_memory: compress older turns; better range, slight distortion risk

RAG_AND_LANGCHAIN.adaptive_rag: LangGraph state machines for routing: decide at runtime whether to retrieve, re-retrieve (corrective RAG), or answer from model knowledge
RAG_AND_LANGCHAIN.corrective_rag: if retrieved docs score low on relevance, trigger web search fallback before generation

OPENAI_AGENTS_PLATFORM.structured_outputs_rule: always define output schema when downstream systems consume agent responses; prevents hallucinated field names
OPENAI_AGENTS_PLATFORM.tool_calling_pattern: model emits tool_call → execution layer runs function → result injected back into context → model continues

API_OPERATIONS.rate_limits: always implement exponential backoff; never hard-retry in tight loops
API_OPERATIONS.authentication: token validation + trust context scoping on every inbound request
API_OPERATIONS.response_variable_extraction: name and extract all API response variables explicitly before downstream use; never rely on implicit field presence

PROMPT_ENGINEERING_RULES: System message controls persona and constraint; keep it stable across turns
User message carries task; keep it specific
Business context is required in the system message for any agent with domain authority
Variable formatting is critical in API calls: malformed interpolation silently breaks prompts
Reasoning models (o1/Claude Thinking): prompt with goals and constraints, not step-by-step instructions; let the model reason
For tool-heavy agents: fewer, well-scoped tools outperform many broad tools

dropped_as_noise: Marketing copy and course upsells (netinja.dev membership, promo codes)
Repetitive UI navigation descriptions across Make/Zapier/LangChain tutorials
API changelog / SDK release notes boilerplate (Retell, Vapi, ElevenLabs, Airtable, LlamaParse)
